candidate.answerReason: Both triangles are right triangles with common hypotenuse OP and equal corresponding legs PD and PE. These are exactly the HL conditions, so the answer is D.

methods.label: Identify the hypotenuse and leg
methods.explanation: \(OP\) is the common hypotenuse of the two right triangles, and \(PD=PE\) gives a pair of equal legs. The hypotenuses and one pair of corresponding legs are equal, so use HL, which then gives \(\angle POD=\angle POE\).
methods.levelReason: Recognizing HL and using corresponding angles of congruent triangles are standard Grade 8 topics.

candidate.annotationRationale:
